title: cli(diff): `os diff` says nothing for a seed dataset in mode `insert`, which inserts every record again on each replay, though it now explains the identical `replace` arm
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eHDXrsKgGAUHq956U

Filing gate: ① product defect (user-visible wording omission in a CLI report), from the contract review of PR #31135 (card #31099), ③ boundary flag 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Reader: the `packages/cli` seat (CLI face) — `packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts` `seedModeNote`, next PR that touches it.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "seedModeNote" → 1 hit (#31099, the source card, which owns only the `replace` line); "\"os diff\" insert seed note" → 46 hits, none about this note.
reach: public entry `os diff` (package upgrade plan) on a package whose seed dataset declares `mode: 'insert'`; read from the code on `main` 5f00374492, not run.
class: c · type: Bug

## What is wrong

After PR #31135 lands, `seedModeNote` (`packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts`) prints for a `replace` dataset "a replay deletes nothing and inserts these again, so rows already in the table stay", and for `upsert`/`update` "a replay writes its columns over the rows it matches". For `insert` it prints nothing. Yet the loader's `insert` arm is the same as `replace`'s: `SeedLoaderService.writeRecord` case `'insert'` calls `engine.insert` without consulting the match, and `decideWriteAction` answers `insert` for `insert`, `replace` and the default. So an `insert` dataset is re-inserted on every replay (a row the database refuses is that row's error), and the plan is silent about it while it warns about the identical `replace` behaviour.

## Who it hurts

An author or agent reading the upgrade plan before installing: a `replace` dataset reads as "inserts again", an `insert` dataset reads as harmless. Not doing it leaves one behaviour described two ways in the same output.

## Owed

Give `insert` the same note as `replace` (or one shared note for both), and pin it in `packages/cli/test/diff-upgrade-plan.test.ts`. Text only; `'@objectstack/cli': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (triage to confirm).

Related: #31099, PR #31135, PR #31083.
